answer_1.quote: We focus on providing algorithms for autogeneration of ML models for complex NLP tasks such as extraction and generation... In this paper, we generate models for both extractive and abstractive summarization tasks

answer_2.quote: Summarization quality is evaluated using F1 measure of ROUGE score calculated between generated and ground-truth summary. We report unigram and bigram overlap (ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2) and the longest common sub-sequence (ROUGE-L)
